prompts.name: 밤하늘 몰입형
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity representative desktop web screen design for the existing Korean product Astune (spell exactly A-s-t-u-n-e). Produce one complete landscape interface image, around 1536x1024, straight-on flat screen capture, edge to edge, no computer/phone device frame, no perspective, no mockup presentation sheet.
Product: a birth-star reading service. A person supplies birth local date, time and city; the product finds the highest visible bright star at that moment and provides symbolic interpretations for personality, love, work and money. This is a consumer experience, not developer tooling.
Important content: brand "Astune"; navigation "별 찾기", "내 리딩"; headline "태어난 순간," on one line and "당신의 별을 만나다." on next line. Supporting copy "출생 시각과 장소로 찾는 나의 대표 별". Clear birth fields with labels "생년월일", "태어난 시간", "태어난 도시", sample values "1995. 05. 05", "15:00", "서울". Primary action "나의 별 찾기" with a discreet arrow. A beautifully composed example reading is visibly labelled "리딩 예시", with "CAPELLA", "카펠라", "마차부자리", short tags "균형", "직관" and four section labels "성향", "연애", "일", "재물". If factual metadata is included use only "고도 81.56°", "1995.05.05 · 15:00 · 서울". Small restrained footnote "해석은 상징적 리딩입니다.".
Make Korean typography clean, intentional and legible like a real shipped Korean product. Limit prose to this supplied copy. Careful baseline alignment, measured spacing, consistent controls, generous negative space, obvious hierarchy, real usable button sizes. Main illustration is an atmospheric visualization of stars, not a scientifically exact chart.
Avoid developer APIs, JSON, code, admin nav, fake reviews, fake testimonials, pricing, invented scores or unsupported features, horoscope zodiac wheels, tarot cards, generic dashboard card overload, lorem ipsum, illegible microtext, watermark, overlapping content. Do not put design-option labels or color swatches outside the actual interface.

Visual direction: immersive midnight observatory, premium and quiet, not gaudy fantasy. Near-black deep ink blue background, warm ivory text and a single soft icy-blue accent. A subtle sparse star field; one bright warm-white star is focal point. Editorial serif "Astune" wordmark and refined Korean sans-serif headings. Navigation small and airy with thin hairline divider.
Composition: oversized two-line headline in the left half, supporting sentence and concise primary action below; a magnificent luminous spherical celestial map fills the right half with fine delicate orbital latitude arcs, sparse points of light, subtle nebula haze only at center. Fine leader line identifies CAPELLA; understated small outlined '리딩 예시' card overlaps only the empty lower-right region of the map, containing Korean star name and constellation. Around lower quarter, an elegant integrated full-width birth-entry strip with three evenly sized fields and bright ice-blue CTA. Beneath it, a small readable four-column reading preview separated by thin vertical rules, labelled 성향 / 연애 / 일 / 재물. Design the header, hero, form and preview to fit fully in the image. High contrast readable text. Restrained luminous effects and exquisite typography, believable buildable web UI.

Visual direction: sophisticated ivory celestial journal. Warm off-white paper background, deep charcoal typography, restrained desaturated forest-green controls, muted brass star accents. Print-inspired editorial structure, generous margins, subtle hairline rules, restrained serif for English star name and wordmark, elegant Korean typography, no gradients, no glassmorphism. Feel human, quiet, timeless.
Composition: very clean top navigation. A spacious asymmetric two-column hero: the left column contains the oversized two-line headline, supporting sentence, then three beautifully aligned labelled birth-entry fields (date/time side by side, city full width) and a dark forest-green wide CTA. The right column features one large circular finely etched vintage celestial chart rendered in charcoal on pale cream, sparse delicate gold stars, and a large editorial caption 'CAPELLA' with smaller '카펠라 · 마차부자리'. This area has a clearly readable small '리딩 예시' label. Below both hero columns a clean open reading preview with four columns labelled 성향, 연애, 일, 재물, tiny star symbols, whitespace and horizontal rules rather than boxes. A charming tiny four-pointed star signature. Everything fits in the frame. This is a refined modern reading experience with antique astronomical engraving used only as a tasteful visual accent.

Visual direction: approachable soft lavender self-discovery service for a contemporary Korean audience. Very pale lilac background, dark plum text, richer violet primary button, subtle pale peach accent. Soft rounded surfaces with excellent readability, clean rounded Korean sans-serif headings, restrained translucent details, warm friendly editorial tone. Sophisticated rather than childish.
Composition: slim top nav. Centered spacious two-line hero headline with supporting sentence; a sculptural pearlescent four-point star and three small orbiting pearl lights arranged asymmetrically in a delicate lilac ambient vignette beside the headline, subtle and not obscuring text. The main lower section contains two balanced large rounded panels: left a crisp white birth input panel with three neatly arranged labels and fields, prominent full-width violet CTA; right a pale violet '리딩 예시' preview panel with a tiny luminous star diagram, generous '카펠라' title and CAPELLA label, '마차부자리', small soft keyword pills 균형 and 직관, plus a tidy four-item interpretation navigation labelled 성향, 연애, 일, 재물. Add a tiny curved dotted orbital motif in whitespace to connect the birth form and example. Spacious, clearly usable and fully visible. Background stays mostly flat and calm; any blur gradients are limited to the decorative star, never under small text. Excellent modern design without excessive bubbly decorations.

Visual direction: contemporary precision observatory interface with a deeply charcoal background, slate raised panels, bone-white text and crisp desaturated mint accents. Clean Swiss grid, narrow monospaced astronomy data and readable Korean sans serif. Scientific confidence and calm, no hacker/cyberpunk aesthetic, no clutter, no neon rainbow.
Composition: minimal top bar with Astune wordmark and small navigation. A compact two-line headline aligned left across the page top. Below it a purposeful three-column workspace: narrow left birth input panel with all three labeled values vertically arranged and mint CTA at bottom; large central celestial visualization taking approximately half of available content width; medium right example reading detail panel. The central chart is a precise-looking circular sky dome with fine azimuth rings, understated compass markers N E S W, sparse bright points, selected star CAPELLA marked with a tasteful small crosshair and delicate annotation '고도 81.56°'. Right panel visibly labelled '리딩 예시', large '카펠라', 'CAPELLA', constellation '마차부자리', two minimal outlined keywords and an elegant vertical list with the four categories 성향, 연애, 일, 재물. Make this approachable for everyday consumers, not professional telescope software. Chart is the unmistakable centerpiece. Entire screen fits, with breathing room below.
